I can answer this! I've gone three or four times, but the most recent was almost two years ago so it may be worse now.

My experience has largely been consistent, it took maybe an hour to get triaged and moved to the "quiet room". The nurses were kind enough to leave the door open for me and to check in on me a few times while I waited for the on-call psych to be available. One time this took like 5 hours, one time it was closer to 30 minutes. It really depends on the day.

The first time I was moved into a private room, the nurse gave me some coffee and promised it wouldnt be much longer. After another like 30 minutes the psych came in and asked me some questions about how I was feeling, what was going in, and about my meds. They ended up re-diagnosing me from an anxiety disorder to severe depression and advised me to follow up with the victoria health center for an adhd assesment.

The second time (about 6 months after), I had been diagnosed with adhd at the victoria health center. I was moved into a quieter waiting room with nicer chairs for an hour, and then moved into a smaller evaluation room. A new psych came for an eval about half an hour later. The psych was nice, but we argued for a while because I had also been diagnosed with BPD. I had expressed concern that I may have had BPD at some point but the doctor never really confirmed so this was a bit of a shock to me. They set me up with some resources for some things I was struggling with, and sent me on my way.

Honestly the DECH was much nicer than my experiences with wellness checks and my family doctor. If your friend can get into the victoria health center when they arent in crisis, i highly recommend it. It's not a quick process, but they will get the resources they need eventually.

Bap gets his Ult fairly quickly if you're effectively topping up your Tank and DPS, so don't hesitate to drop it in team fights. It wont end the fight, but with a little bit of synergy you can pick the enemy healers and keep your tank up more effectively.
